scope: All 6828 Ladybird imported testharness cases; not all upstream WPT types or variants

available: two HTTPS ports with a private CA
new_server_protocol.comparability: r15 used a static HTTP server; r16 changes server coverage and is not a matched regression or speed comparison.

preflight.scope: Three selected cases only, on the published production bundle

guard.metric: sampled sum of process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted twice

supervision.lease: Canonical shared bundle lease acquired after existing jobs complete and held through actual guard completion. Latest completed published build is selected and required source hashes are checked.
supervision.integrity: Executable, native libraries and runner/guard source hashes are monitored throughout; fixture and upstream server inputs are verified by the runner. Changed inputs invalidate all-pass.
supervision.harness_deadlines: Unchanged imported original harness, normal 10 seconds / long 60 seconds, plus 10 second report grace.
supervision.cleanup: Supervisor archives results and receipts, writes durable completion with actual exits, releases its bundle lease and removes completed Build scratch.

full_upstream_status: The full upstream checkout exists. Full official browser execution still requires integrated WebDriver/runner support and services for other test types; these 6828 cases are a subset.
